transcript.line: — NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
PATIENT AIM: first strike, doubled.

📖 "...they ended." The last line lands like a lid. (The story finishes — you die as narrated.)
Armor absorbs 3730.
You go down.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Nadia Khoury is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
Nadia is gone — dead. The errand dies with them; nobody's waiting on those dandelions now.
🕯️ Nadia Khoury is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Nadia kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Nadia's gone." Olzhas looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Nadia." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Vasyl blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
📖 LEARNED: Shield Wall (Level 1). Shoulder to shoulder in the wilds, you brace as one. While an ally fights beside you, blows that reach you land softer — the line holds together or not at all.
📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Nadia Khoury, 97 days. The mantle passes to Vasyl Shevchenko.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Vasyl Shevchenko, 34 — an infantry soldier. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Berserker Rage.
The village's quarrel was with Nadia — and Nadia is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Nadia — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Olzhas, Emil, Boris speak for Vasyl — "Nadia trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Vasyl before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
